procedure: cargo test -p cw-core -p cw-sim -p cw-session. Tests cover generation-checked handles, swap-remove reference repair, stale revision rejection, unauthorised price rejection with no mutation, failed issuance rollback, duplicate command idempotency, and rejected commands returning typed keys.
limitations: Rejection coverage is by family fixture, not an exhaustive fuzz of every command path; P32 remains the adversarial sequence packet.
